import seaborn as sns
import time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(df, letter):
    if df is None or not hasattr(df, "empty") or df.empty or not hasattr(df, "columns") or "Word" not in df.columns:
        return None

    words = df["Word"].fillna("").astype(str)
    letter_str = str(letter)

    if letter_str == "":
        filtered = words
    else:
        filtered = words[words.str.startswith(letter_str, na=False)]

    lengths = filtered.str.len().tolist()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    if lengths:
        sns.boxplot(y=lengths, ax=ax)

    ax.set_xlabel("")
    ax.set_ylabel("Word length")
    ax.set_title(f"Word length distribution for words starting with '{letter_str}'")
    return ax
